# Agent-Tool Sprawl

## Caption

AI agent capabilities are spreading faster than most teams can govern them. Skills, prompts, MCP servers, and internal tools end up in local folders, docs, Slack threads, and repo snippets. Intertool gives teams one approved registry for the capabilities agents actually use.

#AIEngineering #DeveloperTools #DevEx #AgenticAI #AIGovernance #PlatformEngineering #Intertool

## Alt Text

1. Your agents are learning from scattered tools. Every copied prompt, skill, and config becomes a new place for drift.
2. Nobody knows which capability is current. Teams need one reviewed source before capabilities spread across editors.
3. Intertool turns fragments into a registry. Publish skills, MCP servers, prompts, and tools in one approved place.
4. Developers install what the team approved. Approved commands replace guesswork and copied local files.
5. Owners, status, and review travel with the artifact. Every capability has context before an agent can run it.
6. Stop sprawl before it becomes production risk. Use Intertool as the private registry layer for agent capabilities.
